metadata.title: Model Dependent Sensitivity to Semantic Feature Group Outages in Network Intrusion Detection
metadata.description: Executed research code and metrics for model-dependent feature-family outage sensitivity, with twenty random draws per family, training-only information and correlation controls, and official corrected LYCOS Thursday temporal replication. Exploratory statistics, matching diagnostics and limitations are included. Source code repository: https://github.com/mazinalswady-glitch/IDS-Robustness-. Evaluation records are included in the archival upload package. No archival DOI has yet been issued.
